name: Crevice of Dream & Reality, ReAc: Moon

choices.description: Put a card from your opponent's drop zone on the bottom of their deck.
During the attack phase of this turn, if you would be dealt 5 or greater damage, that damage is reduced to 0.

unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: 10th/0038: During the attack phase of this turn, if you would be dealt 5 or greater damage, that damage is reduced to 0.
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Phase-limited continuous damage replacement: intercepts damage dealt to player during attack phase with an incoming damage threshold condition (damage >= 5), setting it to 0.
information_needed: Approved DAMAGE_RULE structure for threshold-based damage negation.

choices.description: During this turn, the attack, defense and critical of all cards on your field cannot be reduced by your opponent's card effects.

unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: 10th/0038: During this turn, the attack, defense and critical of all cards on your field cannot be reduced by your opponent's card effects.
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Continuous stat protection preventing opponent card effects from reducing power, defense, and critical of friendly field cards.
information_needed: Approved STAT_PROTECTION rule preventing stat reduction from opponent effects.

en.plain:
[Counter] 【Act】 You may drop this card from your hand. If you do, choose and use one of the following three.
• Put a card from your opponent's drop zone on the bottom of their deck.
• During the attack phase of this turn, if you would be dealt 5 or greater damage, that damage is reduced to 0.
• During this turn, the attack, defense and critical of all cards on your field cannot be reduced by your opponent's card effects.

[Counter] 【Act】 คุณสามารถทิ้งการ์ดใบนี้จากบนมือได้ หากทำ เลือกใช้ 1 อย่างจากความสามารถต่อไปนี้
• นำการ์ด 1 ใบจากช่องดรอปของคู่แข่งไว้ใต้กองการ์ดของคู่แข่ง
• ในช่วงแอทแทคเฟสของเทิร์นนี้ หากคุณจะได้รับความเสียหาย 5 หน่วยขึ้นไป ความเสียหายนั้นจะกลายเป็น 0
• ในระหว่างเทิร์นนี้ พลังโจมตี พลังป้องกัน และคริติคอลของการ์ดทั้งหมดบนสนามของคุณไม่สามารถถูกลดลงได้โดยความสามารถการ์ดของคู่แข่ง
